Select compounds with IC50 measurements in nM against human Isocitrate dehydrogenase [NADP] cytoplasmic. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays and target_dictionary. Join compound_records on activities.record_id to get compound_key. Join docs on compound_records.doc_id to get pubmed_id_or_doi. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require canonical_smiles. Filter by target_dictionary.pref_name matching 'Isocitrate dehydrogenase [NADP] cytoplasmic' and target_dictionary.organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Filter activities.standard_type = 'IC50' and activities.standard_units = 'nM'. Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
